description: Merges final and shared layouts of an item.

database.description: The database to merge layout for. Only sent when addressing by id -- a path carries its own database prefix (e.g. master:/sitecore/content/Home).

id.description: The ID of the item to merge layout for. Supply this or path.

language.description: The item language to merge layout for.

path.description: The path of the item to merge layout for. Supply this or id.

name: presentation-merge-layout
